tools.name: brief_stack
tools.description: One call answers 'is my project safe?'. Checks every package for known vulnerabilities, tells you which are being EXPLOITED IN THE WILD right now (CISA KEV) or likely to be (EPSS), flags abandoned/deprecated packages, and returns a ranked fix-first list. Accepts a package list or a pasted package.js

tools.name: brief_company
tools.description: One call briefs you on a US public company: SEC profile, recent filings (8-K material events flagged), insider trades and reported financials. Give a ticker, name or CIK.

tools.name: brief_domain
tools.description: One call checks a domain: registration and DNS, email security (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), tech stack, and subdomains from certificate logs.

tools.name: brief_place
tools.description: One call briefs you on a US place: current conditions, forecast, active weather alerts for the state, nearby earthquakes and elevation.

tools.name: koot_watch
tools.description: PRO. Tell Koot what to watch once: packages (or a pasted package.json) and/or companies (tickers). Koot remembers them and only reports what is NEW: newly exploited or likely-exploited vulnerabilities in your packages, and new SEC filings (8-K material events flagged) from your companies. Add notify

tools.name: koot_whats_new
tools.description: PRO. Ask 'anything new?' and Koot reports only what changed since the last check: new exploited or likely-exploited issues in your watched packages and new SEC filings from your watched companies. Great to call at the start of every session.

tools.name: koot_watches
tools.description: PRO. Lists what Koot is watching for you.

tools.name: koot_unwatch
tools.description: PRO. Stop watching some packages or companies, all: true to stop and forget everything, or stop_alerts: true to turn off Slack/Discord alerts.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: koot_watch, koot_whats_new · Public sink: brief_domain, koot_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: koot_watch, koot_whats_new · Public sink: brief_domain, koot_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
